title: Corporate Agreement Relief on Change Fees
content:
**Corporate Sales terms — Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements applied to Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The change fee of a voluntary, standard exchange is multiplied by the **agreement relief rate**, which follows the corporate travel agreement the ticket names. The rate acts on the unrounded fee; the fee is rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Agreement named on the ticket | Agreement relief rate |
|---|---|
| Active, and its tier waives change fees | 0 |
| Active, its tier does not waive change fees, and its spend this agreement year is at least its tier's annual spend threshold | 0.6 (spend relief rate) |
| Any other ticket (no agreement, an agreement that is not active, or an active agreement below its threshold) | 1 |

The agreement's status and its spend this agreement year are read from the agreement's record in Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements; the change fee waiver and the annual spend threshold are those of the agreement's tier.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical threshold of 150,000 dollars)

| Status | Tier waives change fees | Spend this agreement year | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes | 10,000 | 0 |
| Active | No | 150,000 | 0.6 |
| Active | No | 149,999 | 1 |
| Not active | Yes | 400,000 | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A fee of 110 dollars at a rate of 0.6 becomes 66.00 dollars.
